question: What effect does daily abstention from food have on age and death?
premises: Daily non-eating is prescribed as the means.
Age and death are the target condition.
A future overcoming of that condition is stated.
inference: Through daily abstention from food, one will go beyond age and death.
uncertainties: gamiṣyate interpreted as going beyond or overcoming in this ascetic context
plain_english: By abstaining from food day by day, one will overcome age and death.
